indexing.label: Search engines
indexing.help: Off until the shop goes live. On, Google and other search engines may list the kinds of page ticked here, and only on the shop's own address (the store's primary domain); the preview site always stays hidden. Every page names itself as its own address in its language (English at /, Bengali at /bn, the same link words). A Bengali page is listed only after it is marked ready. "Other languages" sends searchers with another language to the English page, or nowhere.

titles.label: Search titles and descriptions
titles.help: The title and the short description search engines show for each kind of page, in English and Bengali. Words in {braces} are filled in from the page itself: {name} the page's name, {shop} the shop's name, {count} how many styles a category shows, {intro} the category's own intro, {pieces} how many pieces a set has, {price} the set price the page shows. A page's own text (typed in for that page, or an AI draft someone accepted) comes first; an empty description leaves the page's own words or none. Products keep their own templates in Catalogue › Names & links. Titles and descriptions are cut to the lengths set there.

aiDrafts.label: AI drafts
aiDrafts.help: Off. On (and with AI on for the whole shop), the AI writes a title and a description for products and categories that have none of their own, from the page's own facts only. Nothing goes on a page until someone accepts the draft here; an accepted draft fills only what is empty and never replaces text someone typed. "At most": how many pages one press drafts. Until an AI provider is connected, a practice writer drafts from the facts alone.

redirects.label: Redirects
redirects.help: Old links forward to their new page permanently (the status code is the one set in Catalogue › Names & links, 301 as shipped): a renamed product or category, a link typed in by hand, a combo asked for with its colours in another order. The old shop's links (the WordPress map, imported on go-live day) forward only while "WordPress map live" is on. An imported old link is kept at least this many months; nothing is ever deleted, a link is only switched off. "Rows shown": how many rows each list of the page shows.

notFound.label: 404 report
notFound.help: Counts the shop addresses that have no page: which address, how often, the last time and the site the visitor came from (without anything after "?"). At most this many different addresses are kept, so a scan cannot fill the database. A suggestion (the closest live page) is offered when this share of the address's words match its link.

urlPolicy.label: Pages that stay
urlPolicy.help: A product, category or page that was on the shop never answers "page not found". A sold-out product page stays: it says so honestly, takes "tell me when it is back" and, with "Available now" on, shows that many products from its category that can be bought. A product taken off or archived the same. A category archived after it had products on the shop answers with a short resting page that sends people to the live collections. Each kind can stay listed in search engines (both on as shipped, so the page keeps its rank); a restock makes the page a normal one again by itself.

hashLinks.label: Old demo links
hashLinks.help: Links to the approved demo (an address with "#/" in it, such as …/#/p/essential-pique-polo) were shared while the shop was being built. On: a shop page opened with such a link moves on to the live page at once (a Bengali page stays Bengali). Off: the "#/" part is ignored and the page opens as it is.

filterPages.label: Filter pages in search engines
filterPages.help: A filtered collection page (for example the polos in navy) is normally not a page of its own for search engines: it points to the clean collection page. Name here only the few that people really search for: one filter (size, colour or fit) on one collection, with its own name in both languages. Such a page is listed only while the switch is on and it shows at least the set number of styles. Off and empty as shipped.

sitemaps.label: Sitemaps
sitemaps.help: The list of the shop's pages that search engines read at /sitemap.xml: one file per kind (pages, collections, products, sets), each split when it grows long. Made from the catalogue on request and kept for the set minutes, so a new product appears within that time. It lists only pages that may be listed, and only the Bengali pages marked ready.

robots.label: Robots and AI assistants
robots.help: What /robots.txt tells robots. While the shop is closed to search engines every robot is kept out. Once open, robots read the shop except the admin and a customer's own pages (bag, checkout, account), plus any paths you add. AI robots (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google's AI) may read it as shipped, so AI assistants can name the shop; switch them off to keep the listed ones out.

altText.label: Photo descriptions
altText.help: The shop writes the English description (alt text) of each product photo that has none; Bengali comes from the dictionary.

verification.label: Search Console and Bing
verification.help: The verification codes Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools give ("HTML tag"). Every shop page carries each code as its meta tag, so the engine can confirm the shop is yours. Empty as shipped.
